package.description: SigmaShake SSG — AI agent governance CLI. Free to install; $5/mo unlocks the value.

en-US.description: SigmaShake SSG — AI agent governance CLI. Free to install; $5/mo unlocks the value.
en-US.longDescription:
SigmaShake SSG (the AI agent governance CLI) is free to download and install.
As of 2026-07-01 winget distribution is reopened (the 2026-06-17 open-channel
discontinuation is reversed). A $5/month subscription unlocks the value surfaces
(rule bodies, the eval API, the dashboard, fleet). Subscribe via
https://sigmashake.com/pricing and sign in at https://accounts.sigmashake.com.
en-US.name: ssg
